info.title: flatin.pt API
info.summary: Portuguese property taxes, machine-readable: IMT and stamp duty (Imposto do Selo) on a purchase, IMI rates for all 308 municipalities.
info.description: Keyless public API of flatin.pt. Numbers are the same as on the site and come from the official tables; every successful JSON answer carries an attribution field — show it next to the numbers. Rate limits: 120 requests per minute per IP address, HTTP 429 with Retry-After when exceeded. Status: https://flatin.pt/status/. MCP server: https://flatin.pt/mcp.

get.description: The yearly urban IMI rate of every Portuguese municipality for the latest verified tax year, or for `year` if given. Where a municipality sets no single rate (it is set per parish), the rate comes with `available: false` and the reason, never as zero. Every answer carries an `attribution` field.

get.summary: The same rates as one CSV file
get.description: Open data: the same rows as the JSON list, under the same licence (see the Link header). An empty rate cell means the municipality sets no single rate, not zero. `year` selects a verified past table.

One municipality by its four-digit code or name, with the rate `history` by tax year and its `movement` (raised, lowered, unchanged, returned, not_comparable). An unknown municipality gets 404 with a link to the full list.

post.summary: What a purchase costs on top of the price
post.description: IMT (property transfer tax), Imposto do Selo (stamp duty) and an estimate for the deed and registration. Body: `value` (price in euros), optional `territory` (`continente` or `regioes_autonomas`), `primary_home` (default true) and `buyer_is_young` (35 or under, default false). Invalid input gets 422 with `error` and `field`.
